Description: There is a cycle OrionTV.Desktop.App -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views -> OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback -> OrionTV.Desktop.App. MainWindow creates PlayerView, PlayerView uses MpvLocalEngine, and MpvLocalEngine uses PlaybackState from the root namespace.

The root namespace has I = 0.25 (Ca = 3 from Views, LocalPlayback and Controls; Ce = 1). Through MainWindow it depends on OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views, which has I = 0.75 and is among the most frequently changed components.

Description: Live-translation setup is spread across OrionTV.Desktop.App.LiveTranslation and OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views. LiveView duplicates provider resolution, API-key lookup and volume ducking, and SettingsView manages provider-specific keys and models, on top of these views' other UI duties.

Media playback engine control is split across OrionTV.Desktop.App (PlaybackController for LibVLC), OrionTV.Desktop.App.LocalPlayback (MpvLocalEngine, MpvHost, PotPlayerLauncher) and OrionTV.Desktop.App.Views. PlayerView switches between engines and mirrors their state, volume, seek and video-output handling alongside its UI responsibilities.
